claims.text: Uber's STS issues short-lived, scoped, single-hop JWTs carrying an actor chain (engineer to Oncall Agent to Investigation Agent), loosely based on RFC 8693 token exchange.
Uber's STS token exchange p99 latency stays below 40 ms.
Uber chose SDK integration over a proxy for agent identity because full provenance is created in the application layer.
In Anthropic Managed Agents, MCP OAuth tokens are held in a vault and a proxy makes the call, so the harness is never made aware of any credentials.
Claude Code auto mode ends a run and escalates to a human after three consecutive or 20 total classifier denials.
AgentCore's Cedar-based Policy layer evaluates each tool call at the Gateway and became GA on March 3, 2026.
AgentCore's Cedar-based Policy layer does not inspect what happens inside the runtime.
OpenFGA documents AI agent authorization and RAG authorization patterns that filter retrieved content by user permissions before the model sees it.
